name: Stage 45:1: Nyköpingshus to Strandstugeviken
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 45:1, Nyköpingshus to Strandstugeviken.
utilities: Nyköpingshus/Nyköping harbour is the reliable start-service area, with city toilets, restaurants/cafes, museum/harbour services, buses, and Nyköping C within walking distance.

The rural/coastal part has few guaranteed public services. Strandstuvikens Havsbad & Camping is the main end-service node with paid camping, toilets/showers/service houses, fresh-water fill for guests, kiosk/shop and restaurant/bar seasonally. Dogs are not allowed on the main beach there, but the camping reports a dedicated dog-bathing area.

End transit is thinner than the start but appears better than older Naturkartan text: current best evidence points to line 2 toward Hasselbacksvägen/Örstig, still with an approach walk and live timetable checks. Older Strandstuviksvägen 3-4 km access and seasonal bad-bus notes should stay as fallbacks, not the only story.
Linudden/Örstig and Strandstuviken have parking/rest/birdwatching access points, but some are reserve, beach, camping, or Arnöhalvön-loop services rather than point-to-point Stage 45:1 services.
waterSources: No verified public potable-water source was found on the rural trail section.
The best city refill is an OSM-mapped harbour drinking-water point near Nyköping; treat it as seasonal/verify-on-site because it is not listed as an official trail water source.

Strandstuvikens camping has service houses with kitchen/showers/toilets and fresh-water filling by the large service house, but access is paid/guest/customer dependent and some food/kiosk/bar services are seasonal.
Kilaån, Stadsfjärden, the sea, and beach/bathing water are not drinking-water sources.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden and OSM relation metadata list stage 45:1 as 12 km. Naturkartan, AllTrails, Äventyrligare and RouteYou show 15-20 km variants, likely due to loop/route-variant handling around Arnöhalvön/Örstigsnäs/Näsudden; do not use those as the canonical stage distance.

The old generated app GeoJSON for 45:1 pointed west of Nyköping toward Fada/Palstorp, which did not match the named stage. The drawn line now uses a point-to-point extraction from the OSM 45:1 relation east/southeast toward Arnö, Linudden, and Strandstugeviken. It measures about 10.45 km and should be treated as best-current direct-stage geometry with 12 km official planning distance; the raw OSM relation members measure about 15.5 km because loop/variant geometry is included.

For route-builder snapping, use OSM node 1816581778 at 58.748679,17.009761 for the Stage 45/Nyköpingshus branch join and OSM/local endpoint node 9926221191 at 58.720582,17.091262 for the Strandstugeviken endpoint cluster. The beach/camping marker around 58.7204,17.0853 is nearby service context, not the route snap endpoint.

Route character: city/castle/harbour start, Kilaån/Stadsfjärden benches and views, Rosenhill/Karlslund/Branthäll, fenced grazing/coastal-meadow areas, Linudden nature reserve, coastal/bird-rich Strandstuviken, and beach/camping endpoint.

Official route text warns that fenced areas may contain grazing animals, usually cows. Reports confirm cattle on/near the route in the Karlberg/coastal-meadow area, including a 2024 comment about cows swimming in the sea. Keep distance, close gates, and leash dogs.

Wetness/mud is the recurring practical condition issue. AllTrails/user reports mention spring mud, July mud/bugs, and route-choice splits; Nya Stigar described parts around Mellanfjärden/Karlberg as overgrown, cattle-churned and muddy with tick risk, while also praising the marking through dense growth. Follow orange markings and carry an offline map.
Strandstuviken includes bird-protection areas closed to entry from 1 April to 30 September. Keep to marked routes/ramps and do not enter closed shore-meadow areas.

Strandstuviken and Örstigsnäs reserve fire rules restrict fires/grilling to manager-prepared places; disposable grills are prohibited. Gas/liquid-fuel stoves are allowed only if used safely and fire bans do not override. Strandstugeviken beach had excellent 2025 bathing-water classification for the 2026 season, but algae/cyanobacteria can still occur; check current bathing status before swimming.
Linudden reserve rules include dogs leashed, no damage to trees/plants, limited berry/mushroom/flower collection, and permission required for organized camps/competitions.

Gästabudet/Örstigsnäs shelter and Näsuddens beach facilities belong to the Arnöhalvön loop/eastern variant, not the simple point-to-point 45:1 endpoint. Show them as related loop options when the user selects the Linudden/Strandstuviken part, not as default point-to-point overnight services.
